title: Add 0.75 opacity to hero avatar image on dark theme
context: The bright hero profile image creates visual contrast in dark mode. Add 0.75 opacity to the .hero__avatar image element only (not page-wide) to reduce brightness while keeping it visible.

tasks.title: Add 0.75 opacity to .hero__avatar in dark theme
acceptance_criteria: CSS rule targets only the .hero__avatar element via :global([data-theme='dark']) &__avatar { opacity: 0.75; }
Avatar image is fully opaque (opacity: 1) on light theme
Avatar image has 0.75 opacity on dark theme via scoped CSS rule
No other page elements are affected by the opacity rule
CSS transition includes opacity for smooth theme switching
